entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel of Innistrad who emerged free from the Helvault, returned and cleansed the world with the Cursemute.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: A silver monolith that imprisoned Avacyn until it shattered in a thunderous explosion; its rubble was used to forge bladed bracers.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon whose release from the Helvault was the price of Avacyn's freedom.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: A Knight-Cathar who explains the price of Avacyn's freedom.

entities.name: Cursemute
entities.description: A wave of spells in which Avacyn cleansed the world with divine fire and turned werewolves into the wolfir.

entities.name: Ikarov the Voyager
entities.description: Subject of the Tales of Ikarov the Voyager.

entities.name: Vadvar
entities.description: A Thraben stonewright.

entities.name: Elder Rimheit
entities.description: An elder who says even storm clouds bow to Avacyn and wonders about primordial forests.

entities.name: Sigrun
entities.description: A former village pariah finally freed from taunting and shame.

entities.name: Gisela
entities.description: A warrior who cornered a murderous demon among the graves of dead villagers.

entities.name: Bruna, Light of Alabaster
entities.description: An angel who declares monsters will no longer find safety under the mists of Morkrut.

entities.name: Ekka
entities.description: A shopkeeper of Hanweir saved from ghouls by gryffs.

entities.name: Terhold
entities.description: Archmage of Drunau who prefers a diplomatic approach and speaks of undead in Stensia.

entities.name: Tamiyo, the Moon Sage
entities.description: A speaker pleased that this world has learned the moon affects more than the tides.

entities.name: Sved
entities.description: A fisherman of Nephalia.

entities.name: Captain Eberhart
entities.description: A captain who warns of a ghoul's eyes and strange survivors.

entities.name: Ludevic
entities.description: A necro-alchemist whose skaabs were killed by cathars and who built a flying monster.

entities.name: Dierk
entities.description: A geistmage.

entities.name: Tolo
entities.description: A person who experienced a first flight held by a geist.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker and vampire who speaks of sacrifice for Innistrad and of curbing vampire decadence.

entities.name: Gisa the Mad
entities.description: A ghoulcaller whose ghouls are imprisoned under her orders.

entities.name: Leukin
entities.description: A patrol leader who ordered his patrol to run from smoldering angel feathers.

entities.name: Captain Lewenheart
entities.description: A captain who uncovered evidence of a demon cult among the clergy.

entities.name: Eruth of Lambholt
entities.description: A person of Lambholt who comments on the cold, dark journey.

entities.name: Bishop Cawle of Elgaud
entities.description: A bishop who calls someone judge, jury and executioner.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire who has seen a hundred mortal families rise and fall and sells corpses with souls as guards.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who came looking for demons and finds angels.

entities.name: Tristen
entities.description: A Cathar Marshal.

entities.name: Kastinne
entities.description: A mother who followed tormentors into the caves below Stensia to free her children's souls.

entities.name: Anje Falkenrath
entities.description: A Falkenrath vampire.

entities.name: Kolman
entities.description: An elder of Gatstaf.

entities.name: Tobias
entities.description: A trader of Erdwal.

entities.name: Rem Karolus
aliases: Rem Karolus, Blade of the Inquisitors
entities.description: Blade of the Inquisitors.

entities.name: Gregel
entities.description: A township militia member.

entities.name: Rorica
entities.description: A woman who broke with her order and led a crusade against the reformed werewolves.

entities.name: Hadaken
entities.description: An alchemist of Nephalia.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: A vampire who urges embracing the savagery of his race's infancy.

entities.name: Alena
entities.description: A trapper of Kessig.

entities.name: Halana of Ulvenwald
entities.description: A person of Ulvenwald who hunts with Alena.

entities.name: Paulin
entities.description: A Somberwald trapper.

entities.name: Elmut
entities.description: A slayer of vampires, werewolves and zombies who feared spiders.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker hunter who seeks to be rid of a curse.

entities.name: Mikaeus
entities.description: An author of writings on faith.

entities.name: Kordel the Cryptic
entities.description: A speaker of cryptic sayings about time and a book.

entities.name: Sigarda, Host of Herons
entities.description: An angel whose devotion yields reward.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane Avacyn's return restored.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: City where peace returned and cathars dwell.

entities.name: Morkrut
entities.description: A misty region where monsters once found safety.

entities.name: Hanweir
entities.description: A place that was saved.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: A wilderness region where those who denied Avacyn took refuge.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: A region containing caves and undead lands.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: A region of fishermen and alchemists.

entities.name: Havengul
entities.description: A city with streets roamed by a gloom surgeon.

entities.name: Estwald
entities.description: A place destroyed by Malignus.

entities.name: Devil's Breach
entities.description: A place where soldiers hunt devils.

entities.name: Midnight Duelists
entities.description: Duelists trained with disarmed vampires.

entities.name: Skirsdag
entities.description: A demon cult that refused to accept Avacyn's ascendancy.

entities.name: Cathars
entities.description: Avacyn's holy warriors who kept hope alive and burned vampire estates.

entities.name: Wolfir
entities.description: Former werewolves turned into allies against darkness by Avacyn's decree.

entities.name: Inquisitors
entities.description: An order taught scripture, philosophy and axe sharpening.

events.summary: A golden helix streaked from the Helvault, which exploded, and Avacyn emerged free from her prison.
events.quote: Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.

events.summary: Thalia states that Avacyn's freedom came at the price of Griselbrand.
events.quote: Avacyn emerged from the broken Helvault, but her freedom came at a price

events.summary: Avacyn cleansed the world with divine fire in a wave of spells called the Cursemute.
events.quote: In a wave of spells called the Cursemute, Avacyn cleansed the world with divine fire.

events.summary: Avacyn decreed werewolves to become the wolfir, allies against darkness.
events.quote: werewolves shall become the wolfir, our allies in combat against darkness.

events.summary: The Helvault was destroyed and fearful mobs became fearless battalions.
events.quote: After the destruction of the Helvault, fearful mobs soon became fearless battalions.

events.summary: Gisela cornered a murderous demon among graves.
events.quote: Gisela cornered the murderous demon among the graves of the dead villagers.

events.summary: Sigrun was freed from being a village pariah.
Leukin's patrol fled when angel feathers smoldered.
Captain Lewenheart uncovered a demon cult in the clergy but the Skirsdag stopped him.
events.quote: The Skirsdag never gave him a chance to prove his case.

events.summary: Kastinne followed her children's tormentors into the caves below Stensia.
events.quote: Kastinne followed the tormentors into the ghastly network of caves below Stensia.

events.summary: Malignus descended on Estwald, leaving only ashes.
events.quote: It descended on Estwald like a sudden storm.

events.summary: Rorica broke with her order to lead a crusade against the reformed werewolves.
events.quote: Rorica broke with her order and led a crusade against the "reformed werewolves."

events.summary: Gisa's lost ghouls shambled through Hanweir after it was saved.
events.quote: Even after Hanweir was saved, Gisa's lost ghouls would shamble through

events.summary: Liliana Vess arrives seeking demons and finds a plane of angels.
events.quote: I come looking for demons and I find a plane full of angels.

events.summary: Elmut, who slew many monsters, never got over his fear of spiders.
events.quote: he never got over his fear of spiders.

relations.note: Skirsdag cultists refused to accept Avacyn's ascendancy.
relations.quote: Skirsdag cultists refused to quietly accept Avacyn's ascendancy.

relations.note: Avacyn's decree turned werewolves into wolfir.

relations.quote: We've tracked Ludevic's monster across four provinces.
